name: h1
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered (H1)
note: Modern Warfare Remastered (H1, Sledgehammer's S1 engine): the decrypted MP exe (h1_mp64_ship.exe), flattened (file offset == RVA). Started 2026-09-29 from AW's profile shape; every address found by disassembly or read off the exe, none from AW.

ghidra.epilogue_tags_note: none yet (no Ghidra project for h1)

rva_note: found by disassembly (load_stream, file_read, push, pop, insert_ptr, load_string(_ptr), globals, blocks, dead block, markers, read return); stream_init, resolve, resolve_deref at AW's offsets from Load_Stream and byte-compared with AW's; decode_ref called by both resolves; alloc the call returning the asset array in DB_LoadXFile's tail, compared with AW's

asset_dispatch.note: the asset loop body (called from DB_LoadXFile 0x367dc9): Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 16), then Load_XAssetHeader (0x382670) compares the type and calls the type's Load_<T>Ptr, as AW

stream.pointer_ifs_note: the string loaders (25 tables, f384680 the asset names) test their field as an IF chain (`!= 0`, then the inline marker): a back reference is the `!= 0` arm with no marker, which the walk records only with this (233,023 on the sample, every one placed by the layout)

temp_block_keep.note: pop (0x39f190) rewinds the temp block (0) to the pushed position; skipped (same code as AW's 0x278be5)

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (the S1ffu100 check at 0x367cb6): the 0x48-byte XFile, stream_init, the 0x28-byte XAssetList raw-read into a static; under push(3) the script strings (0x379fa0) and XGlobals (0x3836b0); pop; under push(3) the array allocated (0x368990), Load_Stream-ed, and each entry dispatched (0x382620)

export.both_marker_assets_note: a SUB* row (a pointer taking the resident marker too, which only an asset loader inserts) is an asset pointer: every one of the 75 readers holding one resolves its back reference with resolve_deref (0x39f2a0)
